load_image_from_url_or_path: load an image from a URL or local file path and return a PIL Image in RGB format
load_image_with_convert_method: load an image from a URL or local path and apply a custom conversion method before returning
load_video_frames_from_url_or_path: load a video from a URL or local path and return a list of PIL Image frames
load_gif_frames: load a GIF file and return each frame as a separate PIL Image in a list
get_submodule_by_name: get a nested submodule from a PyTorch module using a dot-separated path string with optional numeric indices
